title: T2 Water Spectrum Foam Blur diagnostic protocol (non-executable)

tests.title: Baseline device GPU and shader capability
tests.instructions: Record Android API, renderer/driver, GLES/Vulkan version, render target formats, and whether this is the standalone lab or full Raft. Do not infer game behavior from capabilities.
tests.expected: Environment metadata recorded; no PASS for shader fidelity.

tests.title: Positive control: known-good two-pass texture roundtrip
tests.instructions: Requires a future compiled GPU renderer. Render a known RGBA test pattern to an offscreen target, sample it in a second pass, and compare pixel values with format/sRGB/tolerance logged.
tests.expected: Known-good two-pass result agrees within declared tolerance; otherwise lab setup invalid.

tests.title: Negative control: invalid render pass index
tests.instructions: Requires a future compiled renderer. Request an intentionally out-of-range pass on a disposable diagnostic material; never modify Raft assets.
tests.expected: Failure is detected and attributed to pass selection; never silently report success.

tests.title: Spectrum/Foam/Blur original binding check
tests.instructions: Only after authorized original-faithful ShaderLab and verified CB0/resource/sampler layout are compiled into a lab APK. Log per-pass material identity, pass index, target format, sampler and CB bindings; avoid proprietary names/data in public exports.
tests.expected: Every binding is resolved from authenticated evidence; unresolved values reported UNKNOWN rather than guessed.

tests.title: FFT compute positive and negative controls
tests.instructions: Requires compiled GPU compute support and coordination with T1. Run known-good bounded dispatch, then deliberately invalid kernel lookup in isolated test code. Record distinct error categories and GPU backend.
tests.expected: Known-good dispatch completes; invalid lookup fails explicitly; neither establishes Raft kernel correctness.

tests.title: Device comparison and provenance
tests.instructions: After a real lab APK exists, compare the same device and settings against a specific full Raft artifact; record both source SHA/versionCode and separate error counters, never combine sessions.
tests.expected: Reproducible bounded comparison; final water repair remains unconfirmed until integrated Raft device test.
